availability.rule: Missing numeric quantities are null with nonempty reason, never zero; preserve native qualifications and explicit support.

safeguards: No independent-race confidence intervals from correlated contests.
Keep binary and categorical Brier definitions/normalizations explicit.
Declare log-score zero-probability or floor convention; never silently clip.
Interval coverage must accompany width; scores preserve units and exact targets.

expectedMarginError.limitation: Model-implied predictive error, not historical measured accuracy or Monte Carlo error.

assumptions: One modal call per frozen race; complete declared probability vector; predeclared tie rule for observed calls.
Linearity of expectation; no independence assumption.
House mode refers to groups, Senate mode to the admitted conditional pair law.

freeze.electionNightEvaluationLock: Distinct from dated saved edition; no lock inferred from current publication.
freeze.sourceIdentity: Hash exact bytes and bind mapping/version; no source authority from file existence or embedded status.

grade.reason: No researched, owner-reviewed historical threshold/aggregation rubric has been approved.

constraints: Use original same-row winners for winner/chamber diagnostics and same-row pair shares for margins.
For combined House artifacts bind source-run/local-row offsets and combined plan.
No cross-model row matching by equal index.
No cross-chamber joint probability without a separately reviewed coupled model/artifact.

gates: A called winner does not establish final margin.
Score margin only under the declared finality/round/denominator mapping.
Keep unreported, unresolved and unsupported races in cohort accounting.
observedResults.storage: Separate versioned result records; never insert truth into frozen native forecast.

pairMarginForecast.intervalTransform: Apply same monotone transform to corresponding share quantiles.
pairMarginForecast.reverseOrientation: Negate mean/median; negate and reverse the lower/upper quantile tails.
pairMarginForecast.support: Votes for exactly the named pair; not total valid ballots and not group-winner probability.

winnerForecast.personProbability: Only an explicitly exported singleton candidate outcome; no division or allocation of pooled group mass.

houseCurrentDisplay.warning: Ordinary ExplorerRace alone drops House pair fields; use the HouseLiveRaceView extension or native result. Generic outcome.share is intentionally absent for House winner groups.

houseCurrentNative.admission: House live manifest/catalog/operator-review/qualification binding through existing server loader

ownerRequests.request: Confirm dated edition vs explicit evaluation freeze, target/rule/cohort/point/tie/baseline protocol; preserve versions.

Compact derived sidecar from existing arrays for close/decisive pair odds, agreed expected margin errors and joint diagnostics; bind ordered35 columns absent from current archive, chain layout, weights, chamber coupling and review.

Bind existing conditional-shares receipt pin and412 mask to current group draw identity; export only agreed expected margin error/joint diagnostics; reuse historical per-race scores with original source/mask/reference context.
Choose source and implement separately versioned observed-results/status/round/finality mapping before outcome scoring.
